body:
GREG, 2026-11-19 about 02:40Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (43498a6e #1587), verbatim: „+ Kimi, ktos cos czekal. to nie powinno byc tak, BEZ WATCHERA, musi byc wiadomo, kto co ma wznowic”.
SIMPLE RULE for both teams (a summary of rules-waits-and-wakes, which still holds in detail):
1. Every wait names ONE session that will wake it and the exact result that triggers it, e.g. "11330 waits for the 808a landing commit, sent by the Merger".
2. The session that produces that result sends it DIRECTLY to the named waiter as soon as it has it. The producer pushes; the waiter never watches or polls.
3. No conditional "start when X is free" GO. A slot is either free now (LAUNCH NOW), or the GO names the session whose run holds it, and that session sends its END directly to the next named waiter.
4. No watcher, monitor process or polling loop.
5. When a coordinator finds a session idle on an unnamed wait, it fixes the handoff at once: it names the waker and tells both.
Trigger case: on 2026-11-19 11334 held a GO conditional on "D8D4 releasing Central". D8D4 finished, but nobody was named to tell 11334, so it sat idle until Engram::Fable noticed at 02:36Z.
